# Puny World 16x16 - source and provenance

This directory preserves an unmodified reference copy of the Puny World overworld tileset for Town.

## Canonical source

- Title: Free 16x16 Puny World Tileset
- Author: Shade
- Canonical page: https://merchant-shade.itch.io/16x16-puny-world
- Asset license: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)
- Tile size: 16x16
- Main sheet: `punyworld-overworld-tileset.png`
- Main sheet dimensions: 432x1040
- Official download page lists `PUNY_WORLD_v1.zip` and the standalone tileset PNG.

The canonical page explicitly permits commercial/non-commercial use and creative modification under CC0.

## Vendored files

- `punyworld-overworld-tileset.png`
- `Tiled/punyworld-overworld-tiles.tsx`
- `Tiled/samplemap1.tmj`
- `Tiled/samplemap2.tmj`
- `Tiled/samplemap3.tmj`
- `Tiled/samplemap4.tmj`
- `Tiled/samplemap5.tmj`

The Tiled definition contains animation metadata and Wang-set/autotile metadata.

## Transfer verification

The asset bytes were transferred from a public repository copy of the original pack:
`hmcguire0583/SurviveX`, source tree commit `8980baa5d9697b2e8edee0dd6e1015349ff0713f`.

The main PNG has Git blob SHA:
`c267f20f8219d97598b3a925bb8731c1afe17f7f`

That exact PNG blob SHA was independently observed in another public repository copy:
`DazzEzBite/PP-projekt`.

License authority remains the creator's canonical itch.io page, not those mirrors.

## Town rule

Treat everything in this directory as pristine third-party reference material.
Do not recolor, crop, overwrite, or otherwise edit files here.
All Town-specific changes belong under `assets/town/`.
